Owner rule 3 (B2B stays B2B): the only genuine dairy cream powder route that exists in this region is industrial - Fonterra/NZMP "Cream Powder 55" (blend of fresh dairy cream and skim milk, spray-dried, 55 % fat, quote verified) and regional B2B dairy traders such as bestdairies.com (Klang, Malaysia) in 25 kg sacks. Tagged B2B, not presented as a retail offer and not recorded as a candidate because no purchase page binds it to this market. Retail shelves in the region carry non-dairy creamers, whole/full-cream milk powders and whipped-topping mixes, which the protocol rejects.

New LEAD 2026-09-17: tajagro.com (Mumbai) sells "Egg Yolk Powder" described as "Pasturiezed Spray Dried hen Whole yolk powder", schema.org InStock, INR - but only in 20 kg export boxes, which is unusable for a home-baker PDF and above the protocol's 5 kg ceiling.
